headline: Valero Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend of $1.20 per Share
summary: Independent refiner Valero Energy announced a quarterly regular dividend of $1.20 per share payable to shareholders.
why: Valero is one of North America's largest petroleum refiners; capital returns reflect broader cash flow conditions across downstream energy.

impacts.name: Valero Energy Corporation
impacts.why: Consistent cash payouts indicate stable balance-sheet management and solid refining margins.
